title: Information Theory
description: Shannon measured information in bits: how surprised you are, on average. A fair coin gives one bit; a loaded one less. Unlocks the Cipher Loom.

puzzle.goal: A coin lands heads with chance p. Write the information H, in bits, that one toss gives on average.
puzzle.name: Shannon entropy
puzzle.method: Each outcome surprises by −log₂ of its chance; average the surprises over both outcomes.
